artworks.title: Protection accordée aux beaux-arts 1663 (Protection Granted to the Fine Arts 1663) [pl. 24]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Louis de Surugue de Surgis (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural decoration with an allegorical scene in the center. The central oval composition features various figures engaged in a classical allegorical setting. The outer frame includes motifs like garlands, fruits, and columns. Two muscular figures are depicted at the sides, which appear to be Atlantes supporting the structure above them. Cherubs are depicted at the top. The drawing exemplifies baroque style with elaborate detail and emphasis on grandeur and drama.

artworks.title: Alliance de l'Allemagne et de l'Espagne avec la Hollande 1672 Cintre de la Gallerie du côté du Salon de la Guerre (Alliance of Germany and Spain with Holland 1672, Center of the Gallery next to the Salon of War) [pl. 31]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Laurent Cars (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of allegorical figures and activities. The scene depicts a grand assembly with many figures engaged in various tasks. In the center, there are majestic figures seemingly in dialogue or holding court, surrounded by people in different poses. On the left side, figures are laboring with hammers, suggesting a scene of crafting or forging, while on the right, figures in helmets are bearing arms. The composition is within a semi-circular frame adorned with floral motifs. The artistry includes detailed garments and expressions, capturing movement and depth. The title below suggests dedication to themes of warfare or a historical event.

artworks.title: La Hollande accepte la paix et se détache de l'Allemagne et de l'Espagne 1678 Cintre de la Galerie du côté du Salon de la Paix (Holland Accepts Peace and Detaches Itself from Germany and Spain 1678, Center of the Gallery next to the Salon of Peace) [pl. 33]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Benoît Audran II (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a variety of figures arranged in a semi-circular design. The central figures appear engaged in discussion or awakening amidst swirling drapery and clouds. Surrounding them are other figures in dynamic poses, some in conflict while others gesture skyward. Architectural elements and sailing ships are visible in the background, with a decorative border framing the artwork.

artworks.title: Coupole du Salon de la Guerre (Cupola of the Salon of War) [pl. 35]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and engravers Simon Francois Ravenet I and Johann Martin Preissler after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological/allegorical scene. The composition features winged figures around the outer circumference holding scrolls/canvases with scenes of conflicts. In the center, an authoritative figure sits enthroned amidst light. The scene is enclosed by an ornate border resembling a large ceiling dome or medallion projection. The drawing is detailed with shading and intricate depictions of clouds and figures.

artworks.title: L'Allemagne Cintre du Salon de la Guerre du côté des appartemens du Roi (Germany, Center of the Salon of War next to the King's Chambers) [pl. 37]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Louis Desplaces (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historic battle scene. The image features various combatants engaged in battle with weapons and armor. There are fallen warriors and a flag with an eagle symbol. An elaborate arch frames the scene, with intricate foliage carvings. The sky and clouds add to the drama of the battle.

artworks.title: L'Espagne Cintre du Salon de la Guerre en face de la Galerie (Spain, Center of the Salon of War Opposite the Gallery) [pl. 38]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Charles Dupuis (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. It depicts a dramatic and allegorical scene within a semi-circular frame. The composition features several armored figures engaged in a narrative of conflict or celebration, with flags and dynamic posturing. At the center is a figure with a lion. The scene is enclosed in an elaborate border suggesting a classical or baroque style. The background hints at a landscape with clouds, adding depth. The detailing of armor, drapery, and poses creates an atmosphere of valor and tension.

artworks.title: La Hollande Cintre du Salon de la Guerre sur L'Arcade qui donne entrée dans la Galerie (Holland, Center of the Salon of War in the Arcade that Opens into the Gallery) [pl. 39]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Nicolas Henri Tardieu (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a naval battle scene. The image depicts soldiers in ancient armor engaged in battle amidst turbulent seas. Details include a ship tossed on waves with billowing sails and a background of dramatic clouds. The composition is framed in an arch with decorative embellishments along the upper edge. The border design features leaves and scrolls.

artworks.title: Coupole du Salon de la Paix (Cupola of the Salon of Peace) [pl. 44]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and engravers Michel Aubert and Laurent Cars after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate ceiling composition with mythological figures. The scene within the circular frame features a gathering of classical mythological figures, including deities and cherubs, surrounded by swirling clouds. The figures are clothed in flowing robes, holding various objects such as a shield and a musical instrument, and are posed dynamically around a central figure. The composition conveys a sense of motion and divine assembly, with attention to detailing in both the figures and the cloud formations. The outer edge of the circle is bordered with an intricately designed ornamentation.

artworks.title: L'Europe Chrêtienne en Paix Cintre du Salon de la Paix du côté des appartemens de la Reine (Christian Europe in Peace, Center of the Salon of Peace next to the Queen's Chambers) [pl. 45]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and engravers Jean-Michel Liotard and Johann Georg Wille after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene within an ornate semi-circular frame. The central image shows a serene ensemble of figures and symbols signifying peace and harmony. The figures are arranged in a balanced composition, with mythical creatures and classic European artistic symbols. Cherubic figures and attributes like a cornucopia and a lamp are included, pointing to themes of abundance and enlightenment. Lush trees and architectural elements are visible in the background, adding depth. The border features decorative leaf motifs and classical patterns.

artworks.title: L'Allemagne Cintre du Salon de la Paix en face de la Galerie (Germany, Center of the Salon of Peace Opposite the Gallery) [pl. 46]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Nicolas-Dauphin de Beauvais (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical allegorical scene. The scene is depicted within an ornate and arched frame. The central figure is a regal person draped in flowing robes, gesturing towards a cherubic figure flying above, carrying what appears to be an olive branch. The surrounding figures include musicians playing classical instruments and several putti. Abundant decorative elements, such as the intricate border design around the arch and the detailed rendering of drapery and foliage, contribute to the image's grandeur and classical aesthetic.

artworks.title: L'Espagne Cintre du Salon de la Paix sur l'Arcade de la Galerie (Spain, Center of the Salon of Peace in the Gallery's Arcade) [pl. 47]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Jacques Nicolas Tardieu (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a classical scene. The image depicts a large arch-shaped composition with various figures, symbols, and designs. In the center, there is a prominent figure with outstretched arms, surrounded by cherub-like figures carrying items or playing instruments. To the right, musicians are shown playing wind instruments. The image is bordered by an ornate frame, enhancing its grandeur. The scene is set against a backdrop of clouds and trees. The drawing is finely executed with detailed linework and shading.

artworks.title: La Hollande Cintre du Salon de la Paix en face des Appartmens de la Reine (Holland, Center of the Salon of Peace Opposite the Queen's Apartments) [pl. 48]
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Massé (designer) and Louis Desplaces (engraver) after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring figures engaged in various maritime activities. Some figures handle barrels, others are seated or standing. A central figure extends an arm. Cherubs or putti appear in the sky amidst swirling clouds. On the right, a ship and maritime warfare are depicted. The drawing is presented in an arch format bordered with ornate designs.

artworks.title: I Fratelli sono al campo [The Men are in the Field]
artworks.artist: Mosè Bianchi
artworks.description: This is an image of two figures in a dimly lit interior space. The composition shows two cloaked figures in front of a table or altar. One figure is kneeling with their head resting on the table, while the other stands beside them, slightly leaning forward. The setting includes ornate architectural elements like carved columns and possibly a large framed artwork or window in the background. The drawing uses shadows and textures to create a solemn, contemplative atmosphere.

artworks.title: Maréchal ferrant au Maroc [Shoeing a Mule in Morocco]
artworks.artist: Mariano Fortuny Marsal
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on Japan paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene with a donkey and chickens. The illustration shows a donkey in the left foreground and a collection of small birds or chickens on the right. The environment is informal and slightly amorphous, with loose, sketchy lines depicting texture and shadow. The setting is dimly lit, evoking a sense of calmness and simplicity typical of countryside life.

artworks.title: View of Orsoy
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar
artworks.medium: pen and ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Katherine and Alexandra Baer
artworks.description: The sketch displays a distant landscape from a low vantage point. The horizon line divides the scene towards the lower third, highlighting the sky's vastness. A town's outline, featuring architectural elements like a tall spire, a castle-like structure, and a windmill, is depicted with sparse pencil lines. The technique uses subtle strokes, conveying an understated elegance. The color palette is monochromatic, mostly pale beige and soft gray, creating a calm visual impact that focuses on the town's silhouette in the distance.

artworks.title: William H. Macdowell
artworks.artist: Thomas Eakins
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man standing next to a wooden structure. He is leaning against it, with his left arm resting on the structure. The man has a long beard and mustache, medium-length hair, and wears a wide-brimmed hat. He is dressed in a long, dark overcoat, dark suit, white shirt, dark necktie, dark pants, and polished shoes. He is not holding any objects, and there is no visible jewelry. The background consists of a brick-paved ground and a wooden wall with leafless branches hanging in front of it.

artworks.title: Karnak, Temple du Sud
artworks.artist: John Beasley Greene
artworks.description: This image captures a landscape from a slightly elevated point. The horizon, marked by a line of ancient structures, including some ruins, appears low in the image. A solitary palm tree is visible near the center, slightly to the right. The sky dominates the upper part of the image. The color palette consists of soft sepia tones, giving the photograph a vintage look. The structures are detailed with clear outlines against the sky, while the ground closer to us is darker. The scene is tranquil, with minimal vegetation or human activity.

artworks.title: A Standing Courtier
artworks.artist: South German 15th Century
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing confidently with a slight lean to the right. The person has delicate features, an elongated face, well-defined cheekbones, and a pointed chin. They wear a tall hat with a wide brim and feather-like embellishments. The person's hair is neatly tucked under the hat. Their outfit includes a detailed top with puffed sleeves, closed by buttons, and a pleated skirt with decorated edges. The individual's leggings are fitted and slightly wrinkled at the knees. Fabric hangs around their left wrist with scalloped edges. The background is neutral without distinct objects.

artworks.title: Panoramic River Landscape
artworks.artist: Jacob Savery I
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pen drawing of a vast landscape with rugged terrain. The horizon is high, showing an expansive view of the landscape stretching into the distance with hazy mountainous forms. The mountains are rendered with fine lines. The drawing shows intricate mountains, rolling hills with trees, an old round tower, and small structures. In the distance, there are buildings among the trees. The drawing uses meticulous pen lines to create a delicate and textured impression. The color palette is monochromatic with earthy sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Glärnisch Massif in Switzerland
artworks.artist: Swiss 18th Century
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image features a rugged mountain landscape. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, providing a wide view of the scene. The sky blends with the mountaintops, which dominate the upper part of the composition. The mountains are depicted in soft blues and greys. The foreground shows detailed green and earthy tones in a densely forested area and a grassy hill sloping gently to the right. The artwork uses precise brushstrokes to depict textures of rocks and foliage realistically. The color palette consists of light blues, greens, earthy browns, and greys. In the distance, a wooden cabin with figures and animals can be seen, along with a path leading through the landscape.

artworks.title: Gleaners in the Field
artworks.artist: Louis Welden Hawkins
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of women working in a field. Two women are gathering crops or grass into bundles, with a collection basket nearby. More women are working in the background. Trees, a fence, and a sky with clouds are visible in the distance. The painting depicts a serene rural landscape with earthy tones dominating the color palette.

artworks.title: The Beach at Marina Piccola, Capri
artworks.artist: Franz Skarbina
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a coastal view where the rocky shoreline meets the sea. Closest to us, blue waves crash against gray rocks in a spray of white. To the left, people stand near a docked boat on the sandy tan shore. Behind them, a rocky gray-and-brown cliff rises up to the top of the painting, and only a small patch of pale blue sky is visible near the top right corner. The cliff is painted with spots of dark green, gray, and pale yellow. The people near the boat are painted with vague patches of gray and tan paint, suggesting people taking or putting on gray clothing. In the center of the painting there is a pale shape in the water that looks like the head and shoulders of a swimming person. This person seems to be connected to a thin gray line that stretches to a large rock on the shore. The brushstrokes in the painting are loose and fluid.

artworks.title: Arabesques with Frolicking Putti, Animals, and Jesters
artworks.artist: South German 18th Century
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite, heightened with white and gold on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: The image consists of swirling lines and elegant curves, creating an ornate design. The swirling shapes suggest grand, decorative architectural elements. There are cherubic figures holding garlands, a central face surrounded by flourishes, and mythical creatures. Human and animal forms are intertwined in the decorative motifs, evoking a sense of whimsy. The artwork features symmetry and ornate detailing reminiscent of historical buildings.

artworks.title: A Country Lane
artworks.artist: John Middleton
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a countryside path winding through vegetation. Close to us, the path curves to the right, bordered by plants casting shadows. A cottage stands on the left, partly hidden by foliage. Tall trees stand in the background, with loose brushstrokes suggesting depth. The sky is visible, showing fluffy clouds on a blue backdrop. The color palette consists of greens, blues, and browns, creating a serene landscape. The style is impressionistic, focusing on mood over detail.
